lines.en: I hang under the leaf; it's the wind that sways.
I have no legs; I can't walk.

lines.zh: 叶柄动一下，我就摆一下
lines.en: The stem moves and I swing with it.
A whole casing stuck to the leaf's back.

lines.zh: 我在这片叶子上，动不了
lines.en: I'm on this leaf and can't move.
The outer layer has hardened.
The wind turns me half a turn.
The silk I'm hung from holds.
I turned over inside.

lines.zh: 叶子一晃，我碰到旁边的枝
lines.en: The leaf swung and I touched a twig.
No feet, only silk.
I hang along the leaf vein.
A gust tipped me sideways.
The hill wind blows all day.
I hang, waiting for the inside to fill.
Rain hits my shell and slides off.
I'm perfectly still, and busy within.
There are rings of pattern on the shell.

lines.zh: 我听得见叶子被咬的声音
lines.en: I hear leaves being chewed.
I wove this shell myself.
What's inside is rearranging.
Light through the leaf is green.
I won't wait long.

lines.zh: 旁边有个空壳，是别人的
lines.en: There's an empty casing nearby, someone else's.

lines.zh: 我在变，你看着就知道了
lines.en: I'm changing; you'll see.
The shell is brittle; don't press.
No one notices a chrysalis.
The wings inside are still wrinkled.

lines.zh: 你盯着一个不会动的东西
lines.en: You're staring at something that can't move.
I'm on the leaf's back; you're below.

lines.zh: 别碰我，里面的东西会坏
lines.en: Don't touch me; what's inside would break.

lines.zh: 我很快就不是这个样子
lines.en: I won't look like this for long.
Looking up was the right move.
I'm doing something in this time.
What's on the shell, I spun.
Wait a little longer.
I'm not dead.

lines.zh: 你手上没有树脂的气味
lines.en: Your hands smell of no resin
A thin crack has appeared.
Something jolted inside.
The wings inside shiver for a long time
Don't press; it'll break in here.
A little debris fell.
I have no way to dodge.
The shell is more brittle than it looks.

lines.zh: 里面那对翅膀缩了一下
lines.en: The wings inside curled.
One more touch and I'm done.
I'm still hanging on.
This shell has sealed my mouth shut

lines.zh: 你举着叶子，我也吃不了
lines.en: You hold up a leaf, and I couldn't eat it.
The outer layer can't be eaten.
Ask me when I come out.
It's hollow in here; don't feed me.
Put the leaf back on the branch.
This shell blocks everything.
I have no mouth, not yet.
Leave the leaf to other insects.
You're feeding an empty casing.
You touched me and I swung for a long time.
One crack and it's all over.
Don't press with your finger.
The silk holds, unbroken.
The leaf sways because of me.
I hit the leaf and swung away.
That jostled something inside.
I hang in the air, not touching ground.

lines.zh: 你走路带的风就够我晃
lines.en: The wind of your steps is enough to sway me.
Step back, don't brush me.
I'm becoming something else.

lines.zh: 这时候谈这个，不合时宜
lines.en: This is the wrong time for that.

lines.zh: 另一个蛹在别的叶子上
lines.en: Another casing is on another leaf.
We both hang where we are.
Wait until we've both come out.
What's inside hasn't taken shape.

lines.zh: 这些事在外面谈更合适
lines.en: Better to talk about that outside.
The leaf is in my way.

lines.zh: 我不动，不代表我没听见
lines.en: Being still doesn't mean I didn't hear.
Quiet, I'm growing wings.
I do not even have a finger

lines.zh: 地上掉的东西，我看不见
lines.en: I can't see what falls to the ground.
I'm hanging; I can't take anything.
There's nothing on this leaf.
The ground is yours; I cannot reach
A leaf fragment is stuck to my shell.

lines.zh: 壳里用不上外面的东西
lines.en: Nothing outside is any use inside this shell

lines.zh: 等翅膀硬了，我自己去找
lines.en: When my wings harden, I'll go myself.
I can do nothing now.

lines.zh: 挂着的蛹，什么都拿不到
lines.en: A hanging chrysalis takes nothing.
I hear something approaching.
A shadow covers the leaf.
My leaf was touched.
Someone's looking this way.
All I can do is hang here and wait
I'm here, unable to leave.
The wind stopped; sounds are clearer.
I know you're coming for me.

lines.zh: 这就是这几天里最危险的时候
lines.en: This is the most dangerous time of these days.
Don't come closer.
I hear your steps.
The leaf moves; that's you touching it.
The closer you come, the more I sway.
It's getting tight inside.

lines.zh: 再等一会儿，我就出来了
lines.en: One moment more and I'll be out.
Not now.
The wings inside are moving.
I hear you exhale.
The first crack has appeared.
Now you're too late.
I can't touch you.
All I can do is sway.
The shell knocks the leaf.
That wasn't from me.
I have no limbs.

lines.zh: 你打一个蛹，很了不起吗
lines.en: Striking a chrysalis, is that impressive?
A little broke; that's enough.
I was struck and spun around.
What's inside is struggling.
I'm almost through.

lines.zh: 一条毛虫在叶上结了壳
lines.en: A caterpillar made its casing on the leaf.
Silk wrapped round and round.
I changed from a worm into this.

lines.zh: 这片叶子上多了个硬块
lines.en: A hard lump appeared on the leaf.
I'm under a leaf on these hills.
The shell just hardened, not yet set.
I hung myself on the leaf's back.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我第一次晃起来
lines.en: The wind blew, and I swayed for the first time.
The outside has turned green.
I wait here to change.
Fire neared and the inside grew hot.

lines.zh: 我掉下去了，壳磕在石头上
lines.en: I fell, shell striking stone.

lines.zh: 水浸透叶子，我闷在里面
lines.en: Water soaks the leaf and I'm stifled.

lines.zh: 气浪把叶子和壳一起掀了
lines.en: The blast threw leaf and shell together.
The arrow punched through the shell.

lines.zh: 法术透过叶子打进壳里
lines.en: The spell reached through the leaf into the shell.

lines.zh: 我在耗尽自己，为了变成别的
lines.en: I'm spending myself to become something else.
Lightning hit the tree and the shell shook.
Falling into the void, the leaf is gone too.
